A new [[canon]] young-adult novel is written by [[George Mann]].<ref name="AmazonDE" /> It was first revealed around early November [[2026]]<ref name="JediBibliothek">{{WebCite|url=https://jedi-bibliothek.de/2026/11/panini-erstes-halbjahr-2027/|text=Panini: Das Buch- und Comicprogramm im 1. Halbjahr 2027|author=Lukas|date=2026-11-04|archivedate=20261109013304}} {{C|in [[Wikipedia:German language|German]]}}</ref> in it's translated [[Wikipedia:German language|German language]] edition on German [[Wikipedia:Amazon (company)|Amazon]] where it is set to be released by [[Panini]] on [[April 20]], [[2027]] under the title ''Die Hexe von Wakenfell'' (translating to ''The Witch of Wakenfell''). The book is described as a horror coming of age novel with original characters against the backdrop of familiar existing ''[[Star Wars]]'' events and characters and will feature "old legends, dark rituals and scary secrets" meeting with the ''Star Wars'' [[The galaxy|galaxy]].<ref name="AmazonDE" />
